name: Peekaboo Screen Automation
description: macOS screen capture, UI inspection, and GUI automation via the Peekaboo CLI — screenshots, element targeting, clicks, typing, and window control.

name: Rigby Error Pattern Analysis
description: Analyzes error log for patterns and proposes systemic fixes

name: Rigby Eval Grade
description: On-demand letter grading (A-F) of eval records

name: Rigby Eval Analyze
description: Analyzes eval records for patterns and recommendations

name: Rigby Skill Reflect
description: Proposes bounded edits to SKILL.md files from eval evidence

name: Rigby Error Compact
description: Archives resolved error entries into monthly digest files

name: System Eval
description: Full eval maintenance cycle — grade ungraded records, run assertions, compute composite scores, analyze patterns, regenerate dashboard

name: Dream Cycle
description: Nightly memory consolidation — archive, score, promote

name: Rigby Skill Audit
description: Audit Jarvis skill library — structural validation, token pressure, execution health, broken skill detection.

name: PowerBI Navigate & Slicer Filter
description: Shared utility: opens a PowerBI report URL and drives its slicer (text-click, checkbox-flat, or dropdown-nested DOM patterns) into a caller-specified selection state via Chrome or Playwright MCP.

name: PowerBI KPI & Table Extraction
description: Shared utility: reads named KPI tile/table values off the currently loaded PowerBI page via document.body.innerText — raw, regex-extracted, or tile-scan modes.

name: Vault Freshness Check
description: Shared utility: generic Obsidian vault-file cache-freshness check used before an expensive live pull — any skill on a pull cadence calls this first.

name: Eval Signal Write
description: Shared utility: writes the systems/eval-harness/skill-runs/{skill}-latest.json signal file from caller-supplied run metadata.

name: Visual Verification
description: Shared utility: HARD gate for critical human sign-off on a screenshot — displays it, requires an explicit approval or escalation decision, records the outcome. No silent pass-through.

name: Calendar Handler
description: Shared utility: three calendar operations (conflict-check, date-calculate, event-create) with a caller-selectable calendar_backend (M365 default, or Calendar.app), centralized UTC→CT conversion, and event-create verification.
